title: Raven
description: Calmer messaging where you already talk. Raven helps you stay on top of what matters—without bouncing between a dozen screens. Works with WhatsApp, Telegram, iMessage, and RCS.
techStack: TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, AWS, Serverless, EC2

title: Fleetle
description: Fusing real-time OBD data, robust APIs, and advanced AI to redefine fleet management. Fleetle turns raw vehicle metrics into predictive intelligence—automating maintenance, optimizing routes, and securing assets. It’s the smart engine driving modern fleet operations.
techStack: Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Go Lang, Serverless

title: Car Breakers’ Wall
description: Car Breakers’ Wall is a comprehensive platform designed for buying and selling car parts, vehicles, and automotive services. Whether you are a mechanic, car enthusiast, or simply in need of repairs, this app connects you with the right people and products.
